roles.use_summary: Generated spliced/unspliced count data with velocyto v0.17.17 from BD Rhapsody alignments after antibody-alignment removal and MA-to-UB UMI-tag preparation, using mouse GRCm38/gencodevM19 annotation. Experiments were concatenated; Seurat/scVelo performed later selection, normalization and stochastic velocity modeling.
roles.remaining_scope: The exact adapted front end, antibody references, CB/NH tags, author files and all other modifications are unestablished. Native literal MA-to-UB and declared antibody-contig preparation do not certify the full author modification. Downstream scVelo/Seurat steps and concatenation recipes remain separate.

roles.use_summary: Counted spliced and unspliced gene-expression matrices from each supplied single-cell/single-nucleus BAM with velocyto, summed those two matrices to form each sample total, then concatenated samples within species.
roles.remaining_scope: Cell Ranger v7.0 generated the alignments but remains user-excluded from implementation. This workflow starts with existing caller-provided BAMs and actual species annotations. Velocyto revision, command flags, references and sample/species concatenation identities are unreported. Native S+U export excludes ambiguous molecules, distinct from the original Loom S+U+A matrix.

roles.use_summary: Used velocyto.py v0.17.17 to generate spliced and unspliced count matrices; scVelo v0.2.4 supplied stochastic transcriptional dynamics and PAGA transition analysis for the selected mouse cell clusters.
roles.remaining_scope: The raw automatic nearby-version field was null; the direct method states v0.17.17. Preserve that extraction and record the reviewed version separately. Exact flags, author revision, barcode selection and actual inputs are unestablished. This counting workflow computes no scVelo/PAGA velocities or transitions.

roles.use_summary: Reported generating spliced/unspliced read counts with Velocyto from existing Cell Ranger output. Subsequent scVelo analysis was invoked through the separate R package velociraptor.
roles.remaining_scope: The displayed Velocyto URL points to velociraptor, so the executable/package link, version and exact count command are ambiguous. Keep Velocyto counting, velociraptor wrapping and scVelo modeling distinct. Cell Ranger remains user-excluded; no author runtime or recipe is inferred.
